data.name: Falaahi
data.gender_notes: Falaahi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'f-l-h', which means 'to succeed' or 'to save'. In Islamic context, Falaahi signifies a person who is successful in this world and the hereafter, or someone who is saved from the Hellfire. The name Falaahi carries the meaning “Success, salvation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Falaahi usually hope their child will grow to embody success, salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance, signifying success and salvation in both this world and the hereafter.
data.etymology: Falaahi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Success, salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Falaahi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
